provenance: Integration review of the framed Given/Shared/Functions chapters and upstream link-audit changes. Read the changed raw units and exact selected declarations/tests, compared the previously reviewed unchanged material and unit-specific reasoning, and reviewed links, target passages and exceptional forward references against retained chapter context. Corrected stale local-completion descriptions and misplaced/missing definition links. No subagents or independent reviewers were used. Conservative full-source snapshots are freshness inputs, not a claim to have audited every proof tactic.
rationale: The landing md/shared-typing.md#claim-shared.typing.read directly introduces shared.typing.read. Links relative paths and runtime resolution; the standalone read defines mode accumulation and failure. Empty-path success explicitly requires the root object to exist. Compared inline notation, displayed rules/equations, and any code/table with the named dependencies. readPath checks that the root object exists, returns the effective root reference at epsilon, and traverses intermediate occupied slots; enter joins the carried mode with each stored reference mode. A final slot may be empty. The prose describes this read rather than prescribing one type per object. Prerequisites are linked in the retained chapter; the selected body states this subject rather than asking the reader to find a definition elsewhere in a multipurpose chapter.
limitations: Author editorial self-review, not an independent review. Link extraction and byte-range validation do not prove the coverage or clarity judgment. Future notes remain nonnormative and this audit does not assert formal correspondence.
